rationale: Calibration ranks were already strongly informative at epoch 4 and retained the final top half.
Pilot pruning produced no failures and did not show systematic elimination of larger candidates at epoch 4.
Several completed pilot candidates still improved between epochs 8 and 12, including the strongest adaptive TPE candidate, so 12 epochs is a tight final ceiling.
Twenty trials give TPE ten adaptive proposals per seed while three paired search seeds preserve the approved seed-variability design.
The projected search cost is feasible on the measured single RTX 4060 Laptop GPU without increasing concurrency.

compute_projection_method.formula: pilot GPU-hours × (tier total trials / 32) × (tier max epochs / 12)
compute_projection_method.caveat: Planning estimate only. ASHA rung outcomes, architecture mix, thermal state, and final-stage data loading make actual runtime nonlinear.
